units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 41a:9">Kidd. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא עושה ש׳</he> he (the husband) can appoint a deputy (to hand to her the letter of divorce); <he>היא עושה ש׳</he> she can depute an agent (to receive the letter of divorce); <he>הש׳ עושה ש׳</he> the agent may depute an agent. Ib.ᵇ <he>אין העבד נעשה ש׳ וכ׳</he> a slave cannot be deputed to receive a letter of divorce. Ib. 42ᵇ, a. fr. <he>אין ש׳ לדבר עבירה</he> there is no deputy for an illegal act, i.e. the responsibility for an illegal act cannot be shifted to the employer.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:5">Ber. V, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>ש׳ צבור</he>, v. <cite ref="R00295"><he>צִיבּוּר</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁלוּחִים</he>, v. <cite ref="U01243"><he>שָׁלוּחַ</he></cite>.
